title: Cookbook
description: Schema for cookbook.json (format 2) — a cookbook's manifest. Every cookbook carries its identity: `format`, `id` (a UUID, the cookbook's identity) and `rdid` (its readable name, the first segment of its artifacts' rdids). A project cookbook also describes the application, plugin, widget or library it assembles from recipes and ingredients. The artifacts themselves are listed in index.json (index.schema.json); where code lives and which other cookbooks this one depends on are tool configuration, in the repo's .cookr.json (cookr-config.schema.json).

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor support

format.description: Manifest format version. cookr reads only format 2; `cookr upgrade` converts older manifests.

id.description: UUID — the cookbook's identity. Foreign links name it: `<cookbook-uuid>/<artifact-uuid>`.

rdid.description: The cookbook's readable name (`adc`, `adhsdk`); the first segment of every rdid in its index.

type.description: Identifies this file as a cookbook

platforms.description: Target platforms. Cookbook-level default; structural elements can override

notes.description: Informational notes, interview transcripts, freeform material

structure.description: The single top-level structure being built (an app, plugin, widget, or library)

spec.description: Relative path to the markdown spec file (ingredient or recipe)

kind.description: What the element is. Set on the top-level structure; a library's directory tree is its arrangement and its elements MAY be omitted

description.description: Short summary of this structural element

platforms.description: Platform override. Inherits from parent if absent

depends-on.description: Dot-path structural element keys this element depends on

id.description: The source ingredient or recipe: its UUID, or `<cookbook-uuid>/<artifact-uuid>` when it is another cookbook's

source.description: Cookbook provenance — only present on forked artifacts

type.description: Resource category (localization, asset-catalog, app-manifest, sound, data)

path.description: Relative path to the resource definition file

type.description: Signals to the LLM how to weigh the content

path.description: Relative path to the markdown file
